parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation, entry ban or facility ban is documented, and national anti-discrimination and transphobia-aggravator law are climate protections, but the combined regime imposes a documented custody exposure: placement by identity-document gender puts trans women in all-male facilities where they are threatened, and the 2021 watchdog found persistence of serious violations across all deprivation-of-liberty establishments, extending to the island. No working remedy, island enforcement record, or island-specific violence data is documented, and local legal representation is thin. Severity if detained is high while detention likelihood for a visitor is low, yielding elevated risk.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Documented: detainees held per identity-document gender; trans women typically in all-male facilities where other detainees threaten them; watchdog 2021 found persistence of serious violations across all places of deprivation of liberty, extended to island jails.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Not documented. No remedy shown to change placement or conditions in the record.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Document mismatch or any arrest can lead to document-based custody placement in a threatening facility; oversight findings corroborate rather than remedy the practice.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Not documented for visitor bathrooms, wards or public facilities.
federal_state_facilities.protection: National anti-discrimination law covering gender identity is documented nationally, application on island not documented.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: National framework applies directly to the island, but no visitor-facing facility rule is documented.

care_services.exposure: Resident healthcare report found lack of self-determination, long waits and inequitable access by location; no visitor care denial documented.
care_services.interaction: Resident care gaps are not treated as visitor protection; no documented visitor-facing care exposure.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: No trans-specific criminal offence for presentation or expression documented.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Penal and labour codes ban gender-identity discrimination; transphobia is an aggravating factor since 2017, nationally.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Formal protections coexist with documented custody violations; no island enforcement record is documented, so recourse is not shown to operate locally.

minors_guardians.exposure: Senate passed under-18 medical-transition ban in May 2024, opposed by government, status unresolved since July 2024; no visitor/minor rule documented.
minors_guardians.interaction: Unresolved resident legislation does not establish a visitor or travelling-minor exposure on this record.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: No island-specific trans violence data documented; 2020 national combined homophobic and transphobic victim figure is not island- or trans-specific.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Hate-crime/aggravator provisions exist nationally, island application not documented.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: National combined statistics cannot establish island prevalence; predominantly Muslim island and one marriage case show formal-versus-lived gap, not a rate.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Thin local legal representation: no referenced LGBT-friendly lawyer for island towns, mainland lawyer listed as available.
remedies_unknowns.protection: National legal protections documented, but no documented island remedy for detained trans people.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Watchdog persistence over referrals since 2010 with no documented correction increases exposure despite formal rights.

anchor_checks.comparison: Lower severity than 0.25-C: that anchor also had a cross-dressing arrest statute enabling detention, plus birth-sex housing and frequent assaults. Here no enabling presentation offence is documented, and placement follows the document marker, so detention likelihood for a visitor is lower.

Similar to 0.55-C in document-based segregation causing distress and partial denial, but higher harm here: all-male prison placement with threats and watchdog-documented serious violations, not only hospital ward delay, offset by no documented ward rule for visitors.

Materially below 0.75-C: that anchor had brief detention ending in release, counsel access and compensation. Here custody placement is threatening, violations persist per watchdog, and no working island remedy is documented.

parsed.synthesis: The operative regime is national law applied to the island: strong formal anti-discrimination and aggravator provisions, but the one documented traveller-facing system is detention. Placement by document gender, trans women in all-male facilities under threat, and a 2021 watchdog finding of persistent serious violations across all establishments—extended to island jails—form an unremedied tier-1 custody exposure if a visitor is detained. No entry, facility, care or presentation-criminalisation exposure is documented, and national combined attack figures and resident LGR/care rules do not establish island visitor prevalence or protection. With high severity conditional on detention, low documented likelihood of detention, and thin local remedies, this sits in elevated risk.
